ar.title: فطيرة الجلاش بالعسل الأسود

steps.n1: تدهن الصينية خفيفا ويوضع فيها كمية الجلاش كلها بدون تقطيع.
steps.n2: يسخن نصف كوب الزيت أو السمن جيدا جدا وتصب فوق الجلاش وتدخل فرن متوسط الحرارة.
steps.n3: عند قرب النضج يصب فوقها كوب كبير من اللبن البارد الممزوج بالقشدة.
steps.n4: تدخل ثانية الفرن حتى تتشرب السائل ويحمر الوجه، وتغطى مباشرة بعد خروجها.
steps.n5: هذه الفطيرة تستعمل مع العسل الأسود وتؤكل ساخنة.

en.title: Phyllo Pie with Milk and Molasses

steps.n1: Lightly grease the baking tray and layer all the goulash sheets inside without cutting them.
steps.n2: Heat the half cup of oil or ghee thoroughly, pour it over the goulash, and place in a medium-heat oven.
steps.n3: As it nears completion, pour the large cup of cold milk mixed with cream over the pastry.
steps.n4: Return it to the oven until the liquid is absorbed and the top is golden, then cover immediately after removing from the oven.
steps.n5: Serve this pie hot with black honey for dipping.

legacySteps: Lightly grease the baking tray and layer all the goulash sheets inside without cutting them.
Heat the half cup of oil or ghee thoroughly, pour it over the goulash, and place in a medium-heat oven.
As it nears completion, pour the large cup of cold milk mixed with cream over the pastry.
Return it to the oven until the liquid is absorbed and the top is golden, then cover immediately after removing from the oven.
Serve this pie hot with black honey for dipping.
